name: City of Cape Town: Municipal Planning By-law 2015 (on SANS 10400)

review.note: Read from the by-law text on 2026-10-27 (consolidation as at 2020-02-03; the 2022 and 2025 amendments were not read). It is a zoning and land-use by-law: it sets no room, stair, light or ventilation limit the checker knows, so this pack changes none of SANS 10400's rules and carries none of its own. Room, stair and ventilation rules stay those of SANS 10400, which is itself not confirmed.

source.name: City of Cape Town (Council), Municipal Planning By-law, 2015

added: Added: the approval steps and the stated time frames, and the documents list for a building plan application, read from the City pages on 2026-11-11

steps.title: Check the property and prerequisite approvals
steps.handIn: Nothing yet: the property is registered and any departure or environmental approval is in hand
steps.detail: The page gives departure approval and environmental authorisation as examples.

steps.title: Submit the building plan and pay
steps.who: Applicant (an owner, or an architect or draughtsperson with the A1(9) agreement)
steps.handIn: The building plan application with the documents that apply, and the scrutiny fee
steps.detail: Fees follow the City's official tariffs, are paid in full on submission and are not refundable if the application is refused. The tariff amounts are in a PDF that was not read.
steps.clause: Step 4 and the application documents page

steps.title: Circulation for comment, then approval
steps.handIn: Corrections, if the plan is sent back for amendment
steps.detail: The plan is circulated to the relevant officials once paid. Work may begin only after approval, with a notice of intention to commence work.

time.text: 30 days for an area under 500 m2 and 60 days for an area over 500 m2, if the plan complies with all requirements

steps.title: Inspections and occupancy
steps.handIn: Requests for the three inspections (commence or trench, sewer, completion), then an application for an occupancy certificate
steps.detail: The occupancy certificate is applied for before the building is occupied.

time.text: Occupancy certificate within 14 days of the request; inspection requests two days before the inspection

documents.title: Copy of the title deed
documents.detail: A copy of the property's title deed.

documents.title: Surveyor-General's diagram or general plan
documents.detail: The registered survey diagram from the Surveyor-General's office.

documents.title: Zoning information or zoning extract
documents.detail: Correct zoning and development parameters for the property; a zoning extract (certificate) if applicable.

documents.title: Previously approved building plans
documents.detail: Any previously approved building plans the City holds.

documents.title: SANS 10400 forms
documents.detail: Fully completed SANS 10400 forms (Forms 1 and 2 where applicable), signed. Form 3 where a competent person is appointed to design part of the building.

documents.title: Regulation A1(9) agreement form
documents.detail: When the application is submitted by someone other than the owner (the architect or draughtsperson).

documents.title: Application fee or receipt
documents.detail: Scrutiny fees are paid in full on submission.

documents.title: Letter of approval for a departure from the zoning scheme
Consent from a neighbour, sectional title body corporate or home owners' association
Company resolution
documents.detail: Where the owner is a company, trust, close corporation or other juristic person: a resolution authorising the person who signs. Every owner signs when there is more than one.

documents.title: Integrated waste management plan form for building waste
documents.detail: The form for building waste generators, completed and submitted with the application.
